SELECT f.id, f.name, COUNT(CASE WHEN g.id IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(g.link_url), '') IS NOT NULL AND (g.link_url NOT LIKE 'wa://group/%' OR NULLIF(TRIM(p.invite_code), '') IS NOT NULL) AND h.health_status = 1 AND COALESCE(h.is_banned, 0) = 0 THEN 1 END) AS groupCount, f.created_at AS createdAt, f.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM group_folder f LEFT JOIN group_link g ON g.tenant_id = f.tenant_id AND g.folder_id = f.id AND g.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN group_link_preview p ON p.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND p.group_link_id = g.id LEFT JOIN group_link_health h ON h.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND h.group_link_id = g.id WHERE GROUP BY f.id, f.name, f.created_at, f.updated_at ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_folder (name, created_at, updated_at, created_by) VALUES (#{name}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy})

mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(p.invite_code), '') IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('chat.whatsapp.com/', TRIM(p.invite_code)) ELSE g.link_url END FROM group_link g INNER JOIN group_link_health h ON h.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND h.group_link_id = g.id LEFT JOIN group_link_preview p ON p.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND p.group_link_id = g.id WHERE g.deleted_at IS NULL AND g.folder_id = #{folderId} AND NULLIF(TRIM(g.link_url), '') IS NOT NULL AND (g.link_url NOT LIKE 'wa://group/%' OR NULLIF(TRIM(p.invite_code), '') IS NOT NULL) AND h.health_status = 1 AND COALESCE(h.is_banned, 0) = 0 ORDER BY g.id ASC
